infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CRUVO uses your precise location to display your position, heading, and speed on the live group-ride map so other riders in your squad can see you in real time.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: CRUVO needs background location access so your position continues to broadcast to your squad's live map when you minimise the app — for example, to answer a call or check navigation — preventing your marker from disappearing during an active group ride.
